changes.description: Root POJO in package com.neversoft.warehouse. Private fields: long id, String name, String address, List<Store> stores (initialised to new ArrayList). Public no-arg and all-args constructors; getter and setter per field; null list argument (constructor or setStores) becomes an empty list. addStore(Store) appends and throws NullPointerException on null via Objects.requireNonNull, without altering the child's warehouseId. equals/hashCode/toString use Objects over all four fields in the style of Vehicle.

Named area within a warehouse. Private fields: long id, String name, long warehouseId, List<Location> locations (initialised to new ArrayList). No-arg and all-args constructors; getters and setters; null list becomes an empty list. addLocation(Location) appends and throws NullPointerException on null, without altering the child's storeId. equals/hashCode/toString over all four fields.

Physical storage slot. Private fields: long id, String code, long storeId, Integer capacity (nullable; null means no capacity set). No-arg and all-args constructors; getters and setters; null-safe equals/hashCode/toString via Objects.

Catalogue item. Private fields: long id, String sku, String name, String description, String unitOfMeasure. No-arg and all-args constructors; getters and setters; null-safe equals/hashCode/toString over all five fields.

Relationship between a location and the stock in it; the only place quantity lives. Private fields: long locationId, Product product, int quantity. No-arg and all-args constructors; getters and setters (setQuantity is plain, unvalidated). addQuantity(int) throws IllegalArgumentException if amount <= 0 or the sum would overflow Integer.MAX_VALUE. removeQuantity(int) throws IllegalArgumentException if amount <= 0 or amount > quantity. Quantity is unchanged on any exception; exceptions documented with @throws. equals/hashCode/toString over locationId, product and quantity, null-safe for product.

Dependency-free test harness in the style of VehicleTest (FAILURES, run, test, check, eq helpers; main exits 1 on failure). Tests W-1..W-12: FQN/public/package load; reflection on POJO shape and field types; constructor and getter/setter round-trips per class; non-null child lists and null-to-empty handling; addStore/addLocation append and null rejection; equals contract and hashCode consistency; equals false when any single field differs; null-field safety of equals/hashCode/toString; toString contains all fields and renders a full Warehouse tree; relationship test (one location with two products, one product in two locations); add/remove quantity happy paths; invalid add/remove arguments throw IllegalArgumentException and leave quantity unchanged. Must compile under -Xlint:all -Werror (no raw types or unchecked code).

Change only the scripts.test string: add the five warehouse source files and WarehouseTest.java to the existing javac invocation (keeping --release 25 -Xlint:all -Werror and the Vehicle files), keep the existing java -cp "$OUT" com.neversoft.vehicle.VehicleTest step, and append && java -cp "$OUT" com.neversoft.warehouse.WarehouseTest. Inner quotes stay escaped so the JSON remains valid.

interfaces.name: Warehouse
interfaces.signature: public class Warehouse { Warehouse(); Warehouse(long id, String name, String address, List<Store> stores); void addStore(Store store); List<Store> getStores(); void setStores(List<Store> stores); }
interfaces.notes: getStores never returns null; a null list argument becomes an empty ArrayList; addStore throws NullPointerException on null. Plus getter/setter per field and equals/hashCode/toString.

interfaces.name: Store
interfaces.signature: public class Store { Store(); Store(long id, String name, long warehouseId, List<Location> locations); void addLocation(Location location); List<Location> getLocations(); void setLocations(List<Location> locations); }
interfaces.notes: getLocations never returns null; a null list argument becomes an empty ArrayList; addLocation throws NullPointerException on null. Plus getter/setter per field and equals/hashCode/toString.

interfaces.name: Location
interfaces.signature: public class Location { Location(); Location(long id, String code, long storeId, Integer capacity); Integer getCapacity(); }
interfaces.notes: capacity null means no capacity set. Plus getter/setter per field and equals/hashCode/toString.

interfaces.name: Product
interfaces.signature: public class Product { Product(); Product(long id, String sku, String name, String description, String unitOfMeasure); }
interfaces.notes: Plus getter/setter per field and equals/hashCode/toString.

interfaces.name: StockItem
interfaces.signature: public class StockItem { StockItem(); StockItem(long locationId, Product product, int quantity); void addQuantity(int amount); void removeQuantity(int amount); }
interfaces.notes: addQuantity throws IllegalArgumentException if amount <= 0 or the sum exceeds Integer.MAX_VALUE; removeQuantity throws IllegalArgumentException if amount <= 0 or amount > current quantity. Quantity unchanged on exception. Plus getter/setter per field and equals/hashCode/toString.

data_changes: None apart from the scripts.test string in package.json; no migrations, schemas, flags or env vars.

test_approach.what: W-1: the five classes load by fully qualified name, are public and are in com.neversoft.warehouse. The npm test run itself proves the sources compile with -Xlint:all -Werror and that VehicleTest still passes.

W-10 (one location holding two products, one product stocked in two locations) and W-11/W-12 (add and remove stock, rejected removals), written as Given/When/Then comments in the style of VehicleTest.
W-4, W-5, W-9: build a Warehouse -> Store -> Location tree, check child lists are never null, append children, and print the whole tree without recursion.

W-2, W-3, W-6, W-7, W-8: reflection checks on POJO shape, constructor/getter/setter round-trips per class, and the equals/hashCode/toString contract including null fields; W-12 checks each invalid StockItem argument individually.

rollout: 1) Create the five classes in src/main/java/com/neversoft/warehouse/ (order: Product, Location, Store, Warehouse, StockItem). 2) Create WarehouseTest.java. 3) Edit package.json last, then run npm test and confirm both VehicleTest and WarehouseTest pass with no compiler warnings. No flags; the change is additive and only the test script changes in an existing file, so Vehicle behaviour is unchanged.
